title: Hadiyya
text: Hadiyya, part of the Cushitic branch of the Afro-Asiatic language family, is spoken primarily in the Hadiyya Zone of Ethiopia. It boasts around 1.3 million speakers. Hadiyya has a rich oral tradition and is vital to the cultural identity of its speakers.
